title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant

High-Growth Manufacturing Business

Derbyshire (one day work from home after 3 month probation)

£30k - £32k + Full Study Support

8am - 5pm Monday - Thursday, 12pm finish on Fridays

Eaton Syalon is partnering with an investor-backed manufacturing organisation in Derbyshire that has achieved exceptional triple-digit growth over the past 36 months. As the business continues to scale, they are looking to appoint an Assistant Accountant to join their expanding finance team.

This is an outstanding opportunity to gain broad exposure across financial accounting, reporting, accounts receivable, operational finance, and month-end processes - all while receiving full study support and a clear pathway to becoming a fully qualified Accountant.

The Role

The successful candidate will support the finance function across a wide range of accounting and reporting activities, including:

Performing bank reconciliations and maintaining accurate cash book postings

Supporting the preparation of VAT returns and national statistics reporting

Assisting with maintaining the trial balance and updating supporting schedules

Preparing and posting journals including accruals, prepayments, and fixed asset depreciation

Producing and issuing sales invoices and credit notes

Maintaining the sales ledger and ensuring customer account accuracy

Providing weekly debtor cash updates and monitoring customer advances

Supporting month-end close processes including reconciliations and reporting

Preparing monthly reports including Other Debtors, GRNI, and cost centre review packs

Assisting with cost centre reviews through analysis preparation and participation in review meetings

Producing daily operational reports such as Hours vs Budget

Processing and reconciling intercompany recharges on a monthly basis

Ensuring intercompany balances are accurately recorded and fully supported

Assisting with year-end activities and responding to audit requests

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates who are:

AAT studying or qualified or someone in the early stages of CIMA/ACCA studies

Equipped with previous finance or accounts experience

Comfortable working with Excel and finance systems

Organised with strong attention to detail

Proactive, eager to learn, and keen to develop professionally

Looking for a long-term opportunity with progression into a qualified accounting role

What's on Offer

Clear progression route to becoming a qualified Accountant - full study support on offer

Exposure to a thriving manufacturing environment

Opportunity to join a business during an exciting phase of sustained growth

Supportive and collaborative finance team

Broad role offering genuine development and commercial exposure

Candidates currently working in an Accountancy Practice setting or those currently in industry will be considered for this role. It's a great opportunity to use as a first move into industry if you are 12-24 months into a career in practice and looking to make a move to industry. The role is equally suited to candidates already in an industry setting.

If you're looking for a role where you can build your accounting career within a dynamic, high-growth business, we'd love to hear from you.

Note - a full driving licence is required due to the location of the role.

title: Finance Administration Assistant
description:
Finance Administration Assistant

Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK Burnaston Fixed-Term Contract 6 months £26,000 £30,000 pro rata

Looking to start your career in finance with one of the world's best-known manufacturers?

Toyota Motor Manufacturing UK is looking for a Finance Administration Assistant to join the Cost Management team at its Burnaston manufacturing plant.

You don't need previous finance experience. If you're strong with numbers, confident using Excel and have a good eye for detail, Toyota will provide the training you need to build your career in finance.

About Toyota

Toyota's Burnaston plant is one of the UK's leading automotive manufacturing sites and has been part of the local community since the early 1990s.

The site is home to more than 2,000 team members and plays an important role in Toyota's European manufacturing operations, producing vehicles for markets around the world.

You'll be joining an established finance team within a highly structured manufacturing environment, gaining practical experience that goes well beyond basic administration.

The Role

As a Finance Administration Assistant, you'll support the Cost Management team across a variety of finance, accounting and cost-control activities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Finance Specialists with monthly accounting activities and cost tracking
- Preparing and checking financial documents, quotes, invoices and cost information
- Reconciling invoices against original quotes and investigating discrepancies
- Supporting cost recovery and claims processes
- Helping prepare monthly accounts and reporting packs
- Supporting journal preparation and posting
- Dealing with cost and finance queries from across the business
- Supporting purchasing activities, including raising and approving orders
- Assisting with stocktake preparation
- Maintaining accurate records and Excel spreadsheets
- Working with engineers, finance specialists and other teams to resolve queries
- Supporting project-specific cost tracking and reporting

The role will give you exposure to different areas of finance, including accounting, cost management, reconciliation, cost recovery, purchasing and project finance.

What we're looking for

This is an entry-level opportunity, so previous finance experience isn't essential. Toyota will provide job-specific training.

We're looking for someone with:
- A-levels including Maths, ideally grade A or B
- Strong working knowledge of Excel
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to collect, organise and manage data accurately
- Good problem-solving skills
- A hands-on attitude and willingness to learn
- Strong communication skills
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Drive, enthusiasm and a flexible approach to changing priorities

A full UK driving licence may also be required depending on the area of the Cost Management team you support.

Why Toyota?

This isn't simply an administration role.

It's an opportunity to start building a career in finance inside a world-leading automotive manufacturer, working alongside experienced Finance Specialists and gaining hands-on exposure to real accounting and cost-management processes.

You'll receive training, develop your Excel and financial skills and gain experience across multiple areas of the finance function.

If you've got a strong Maths background, enjoy working with numbers and want to get your foot in the door with Toyota, we'd like to hear from you.

ATA is committed to creating a diverse workforce and is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of age, disability, gender, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
£27,000 - £30,000
Derby/Nottingham border
Temporary 3-6 months
Office-based

We're looking for an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on a temporary basis for an initial 3-6 months. The location is well suited to candidates commuting from either the Nottingham or Derby area.

This is a hands-on Credit Control position focused on getting the cash in. You'll manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, monitor aged debt, proactively chase outstanding invoices and work with internal teams and customers to resolve anything holding up payment.

The role will include:
- Managing an allocated portfolio of customer accounts
- Monitoring aged debt and prioritising outstanding balances
- Chasing overdue invoices by phone, email and written correspondence
- Having regular conversations with customers to secure payment
- Investigating and resolving invoice, pricing and payment queries
- Liaising with Sales, Customer Service and Operations to resolve issues
- Reconciling customer accounts and allocating incoming payments
- Downloading and posting cash receipts
- Running and sending customer statements
- Escalating overdue or high-risk accounts where required
- Supporting credit checks and the opening of new customer accounts
- Reviewing customer accounts and highlighting potential credit risks
- Producing and reviewing aged debt reports
- Reporting collection issues and higher-risk accounts to the Credit Manager
- Supporting month-end and year-end finance processes
- Working with external collection agencies or solicitors where required
- Providing cover for colleagues during periods of absence

About you:
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or a similar finance role
- Confident speaking to customers and chasing outstanding payments
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Comfortable dealing with queries and following issues through to resolution
- Good numerical and analytical ability
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage your own workload
- Good Excel skills - advanced Excel would be useful, but isn't essential
- Comfortable working with finance systems and able to pick up new systems quickly
- A proactive approach, with the persistence to keep chasing when payment isn't forthcoming

The most important thing for this role is a genuine focus on cash collection. You'll need to be comfortable picking up the phone, having those payment conversations and taking ownership of your ledger rather than waiting for problems to resolve themselves.

The position is office-based, working either 8:30am-4:30pm or 9:00am-5:00pm.

This is an initial 3-6 month temporary contract, with the longer-term requirement still to be determined, based on performance.

If you're an experienced Credit Controller looking for a new opportunity and enjoy a role where you can make a real impact on cash flow, we'd like to hear from you.

title: HR Assistant
company: Bowmer And Kirkland Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Assistant

Location: Heage, Derbyshire

Salary: Competitive.

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

About Bowmer + Kirkland:

Since being established in 1923 Bowmer + Kirkland has grown to become one of the most successful privately-owned, and family run construction groups in the UK. Our Investors in People accreditation demonstrates our commitment to our staff and we are Scheme Partners of the Considerate Constructors Scheme - something which only a select number of high performing contractors achieve.

We are looking to recruit an HR Assistant to coordinate and take ownership of key operational HR processes across the employee lifecycle, acting as a trusted first point of contact for employees and managers and providing accurate, timely guidance within agreed policies and procedures. The HR Assistant will support with routine casework and correspondence, and work closely with HR Advisors to ensure matters are progressed effectively. The role will use judgement to resolve queries, improve HR processes and data quality, and contribute to HR projects.

Duties of the Role:
- Support the admin team with the end-to-end new starter process, including preparing offers and contracts, obtaining approvals and required information, liaising with stakeholders, resolving gaps and ensuring a professional onboarding experience.
- Take responsibility for the accuracy and integrity of employee records, HR systems, files and trackers, carrying out regular checks, investigating discrepancies and driving timely corrective action.
- Support the admin team with the leaver process from notification through to completion, advising managers on required steps, preparing documentation, liaising with relevant departments and ensuring actions are closed within timescales.
- Coordinate routine family-friendly leave cases, providing employees and managers with clear process guidance, monitoring key dates and entitlements, and working with HR Advisors and Payroll on more complex matters.
- Support the administration and workflow for flexible working requests, advising on the process, monitoring statutory and internal timescales, preparing documentation and highlighting potential risks or inconsistencies for HR Advisor review.
- Act as a knowledgeable first point of contact for the HR inbox, independently resolving routine policy and process queries, triaging casework and allocating or escalating matters based on urgency, complexity and risk.
- Coordinate the operational requirements of employee relations cases, maintaining case plans and records, preparing documentation, tracking actions and deadlines, and identifying missing information or procedural risks for the HR Advisor.
- Support the recruitment administration on Itrent, liaising with the communications department to get the vacancy onto the website. Support the Recruitment Business Partner and Recruitment Lead with any administration.
- Produce routine HR management information and reports, interpreting data to identify trends, gaps and required actions, and support HR projects, policy reviews and system or process improvements.
- Build trusted working relationships with employees, managers, Directors and external partners, using professional judgement to influence timely action, clarify responsibilities and maintain confidence in the HR service.
- Manage own workload and priorities with a high degree of autonomy, contribute ideas to improve the HR service, share knowledge with colleagues and undertake other duties that support team and business objectives.

Key Skills & Experience Required:
- Strong coordination and written communication; sound judgement; attention to detail; understanding of contractual documentation, confidentiality and GDPR.
- Strong IT and data management skills; analytical approach; high level of accuracy; understanding of data protection and record-retention requirements.
- Ability to manage a process independently; confident stakeholder communication; discretion; ability to identify and escalate risk.
- Sensitivity and professionalism; developing employment-law knowledge; confident communication; ability to manage deadlines and interdependencies.
- Customer focus; working knowledge of HR policies; sound judgement; confident verbal and written communication; ability to manage competing priorities.
- Discretion; case coordination; attention to detail; resilience; understanding of fair process and sensitive employee matters.
- Organisational skills, professional communication; working knowledge of flexible working requirements; judgement and confidence to raise concerns.
- Strong Excel and analytical skills; ability to present information clearly; project coordination; curiosity and continuous-improvement mindset.
- Strong interpersonal skills; confidence; diplomacy; influencing skills; discretion and integrity.
- Proactive and adaptable approach; accountability; problem-solving; teamwork; commitment to continuous professional development.

In return we offer:
- 25 days holiday per year, plus 8 bank holidays & Christmas Eve
- Entry into the Group Personal Pension Scheme
- Private Health Insurance (subject to a qualifying period)
- Enhanced family friendly policies (subject to qualifying period)
- Eye care voucher scheme
- Training & Development Opportunities

If you're interested in the role and would like to put yourself forward, please hit APPLY and attach your CV and Cover Letter.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of: HR Advisor, HR Generalist, HR Officer, HR Analyst, HR Data Analyst, Human Resource Analyst, HR Assistant, HR Adviser, HR Coordinator, Human Resource Advisor may also be considered for this role.

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
Technical Project Coordinator
Location: Little Eaton, Derby
Salary: (phone number removed)
Working Pattern: Office-based with the potential for 1 day per week working from home
The Opportunity
We are recruiting for a Technical Project Coordinator to join a growing and ambitious digital services business based in Derbyshire.
This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organised and customer-focused individual who enjoys managing multiple projects, building strong client relationships and working closely with technical teams to deliver outstanding results.
You'll play a key role in coordinating website implementation projects, acting as the link between clients and internal teams to ensure projects are delivered effectively and on schedule.

The Role
As a Technical Project Coordinator, you will take ownership of projects from initial handover through to successful delivery and launch.
You'll be the primary point of contact for clients throughout the onboarding journey, ensuring expectations are managed, timelines are maintained and communication remains clear at every stage.
This role would suit someone who enjoys problem-solving, has excellent attention to detail and is comfortable working within a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage multiple client projects simultaneously from onboarding through to completion
- Act as the main point of contact for clients via telephone, Microsoft Teams and email
- Build strong client relationships and provide a first-class customer experience
- Coordinate project activity between clients and internal technical teams
- Gather project requirements, content and information required for delivery
- Monitor project progress and ensure agreed deadlines and milestones are achieved
- Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impact delivery timelines
- Coordinate feedback and approvals throughout the project lifecycle
- Carry out quality checks and ensure projects meet agreed requirements before launch
- Deliver client training and support where required
- Maintain accurate project updates and documentation

About You
We're looking for someone who combines strong organisational skills with excellent communication abilities and a genuine passion for delivering a positive client experience.
You don't need to be a technical expert, but you will have a logical and technical mindset, be comfortable learning new systems and be able to communicate effectively with both clients and technical teams.
Skills & Experience
Essential
- Previous experience within a project coordination, implementation, onboarding, account management or client services role
- Strong customer-facing communication skills
- Experience managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
- Confident leading client conversations via phone and video meetings
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong problem-solving abilities
- High attention to detail
- Proactive and accountable approach to work
- Comfortable working with technical information and systems

Desirable
- Experience coordinating digital, software or website-related projects
- Experience working within an agency or client-facing environment
- Knowledge of project management tools and processes
- Experience onboarding customers to digital products or services
